title: Double-Precision Coordinate System
description: Demonstrates xeokit's transparent 64-bit coordinate system support. A city block is placed at real UTM coordinates (~474,000 m easting, ~5,561,000 m northing) and a tower crane animates at those large coordinates with sub-millimetre precision. A live overlay shows the raw Float64 world coordinates to make clear why standard WebGL float32 scenes would jitter at this scale.
